source.reuse_scope: Algorithm description only; implementation, workload, oracles, and prose are clean-room.

contract.operation: Build a fixed-base stabilizer chain from permutation generators, return the group order, and answer membership queries.
contract.permutation_encoding: Each permutation is a sequence of zero-based images; applying p then q maps i to q[p[i]].
contract.input_layout: [N, M, Q, M permutations of N images, then Q membership permutations of N images]
contract.queries: Each query is one permutation of {0,...,N-1}; output 1 if it belongs to the generated group, else 0.
contract.algorithm: Incremental Schreier-Sims with a fixed base 0..N-1: sift candidate residues through orbit transversals, insert residues outside the represented subgroup, rebuild the affected orbit, and propagate Schreier residues to the next stabilizer. The symmetric strong-generator sets and orbit representatives form a stabilizer chain.
contract.output_layout: One little-endian signed 64-bit group order, followed by one little-endian signed 64-bit membership flag per query.
contract.internal_capacity: At most 32 strong generators per layer and 8192 queued Schreier residues; the degree-six group-order bound is 720.
contract.error_policy: Malformed dimensions, values, or non-permutations return -1. Valid input with null output or capacity below 8*(Q+1) returns -2 without writes.
contract.complexity: With B independent strong-generator insertions over all layers, fixed N<=6 bounds the incremental construction by O(B^2*N^3); a membership query is O(N^3) with compact base-7 permutation codes. Chain storage is O(N*B), with a fixed bounded pending-residue queue.
